              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* MODE 5: EXPORT TO QUIZLET.COM */}
          {mode === 'export' && (
            <div className="w-full max-w-xl space-y-5 animate-fade-in">
              <div className="bg-purple-500/10 border border-purple-500/20 p-4 rounded-2xl text-xs text-purple-200 space-y-2">
                <h4 className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 text-purple-300">
                  <ExternalLink size={14} /> Cách nạp nhanh vào Quizlet.com:
                </h4>
                <ol className="list-decimal list-inside space-y-1 text-gray-300">
                  <li>Bấm nút <strong>"Sao chép toàn bộ thẻ"</strong> bên dưới.</li>
                  <li>Truy cập <a href="https://quizlet.com/create-set" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="text-purple-400 underline font-semibold">quizlet.com/create-set</a></li>
                  <li>Bấm vào <strong>"Nhập từ Word, Excel, Google Docs"</strong> và dán (Ctrl+V / Cmd+V) vào ô. Xong!</li>
                </ol>
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-1.5">
                  <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400">Dữ liệu định dạng Tab-Separated:</label>
                  <button
                    onClick={handleCopyExport}
                    className="text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white flex items-center gap-1 transition"
                  >
                    {copied ? <CheckCheck size={14} className="text-green-400" /> : <Copy size={14} />}
                    <span>{copied ? "Đã sao chép!" : "Sao chép toàn bộ"}</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
                <textarea
                  readOnly
                  value={cards.map(c => `${c.front}\t${c.back}`).join('\n')}
                  rows={8}
                  className="w-full bg-black/40 border border-white/15 rounded-xl p-3 font-mono text-xs text-gray-300 focus:outline-none select-all"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end">
                <a
                  href="https://quizlet.com/create-set"
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noreferrer"
                  className="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-purple-600 hover:opacity-90 text-white font-semibold text-xs px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl transition flex items-center gap-2 shadow-lg"
                >
                  Mở trang tạo học phần Quizlet.com <ExternalLink size={14} />
                </a>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className={`p-4 border-t flex items-center justify-between text-xs ${
          isDark ? 'border-white/10 bg-white/[0.01] text-gray-500' : 'border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 text-gray-500'
        }`}>
          <span>Hỗ trợ ôn luyện ghi nhớ ngắt quãng Spaced Repetition & Ghép thẻ tương tác.</span>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-gray-200 transition font-medium">
            Đóng
          </button>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}



# ==============================================================================
# FILE: frontend/src/components/SettingsModal.jsx
# ==============================================================================

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { X, Check, Server, Key, Cpu, Cloud, RefreshCw, AlertCircle, Eye, EyeOff, ExternalLink } from 'lucide-react';
import axios from 'axios';

export default function SettingsModal({ isOpen, onClose, onSettingsSaved }) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('local'); // 'local' or 'cloud'
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [scanning, setScanning] = useState(false);
  const [localStatus, setLocalStatus] = useState({ ollama: { available: false, models: [] }, lm_studio: { available: false, models: [] } });
  
  // Settings State
  const [settings, setSettings] = useState({
    default_provider: 'ollama',
    default_model: 'qwen2.5:3b',
    ollama_base_url: 'http://localhost:11434',
    lm_studio_base_url: 'http://localhost:1234/v1',
    gemini_api_key: '',
    gemini_model: 'gemini-2.5-flash',
    openai_api_key: '',
    openai_model: 'gpt-4o-mini',
    groq_api_key: '',
    groq_model: 'llama-3.3-70b-versatile',
    openrouter_api_key: '',
    openrouter_model: 'deepseek/deepseek-r1',
    router9_base_url: 'http://localhost:20128/v1',
    router9_api_key: '',
    router9_model: 'claude-3-5-sonnet',
    custom_base_url: '',
    custom_api_key: '',
    custom_model: ''
  });

  const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState({});
  const [testingProvider, setTestingProvider] = useState(null);
  const [showKeys, setShowKeys] = useState({});

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) {
      loadSettings();
      scanLocalModels();
    }
  }, [isOpen]);

  const loadSettings = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await axios.get('/api/settings');
      if (res.data) {
        setSettings(prev => ({ ...prev, ...res.data }));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Lỗi tải cài đặt:", e);
    }
  };

  const scanLocalModels = async () => {
    setScanning(true);
    try {
      const res = await axios.get('/api/llm/local-models');
      setLocalStatus(res.data);
      // Nếu có model ollama mà default_model rỗng, chọn model đầu tiên
      if (res.data?.ollama?.models?.length > 0 && (!settings.default_model || settings.default_model === 'qwen2.5:3b')) {
        const found = res.data.ollama.models.find(m => m.name === settings.default_model);
        if (!found) {
          setSettings(prev => ({ ...prev, default_model: res.data.ollama.models[0].name }));
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Lỗi quét local models:", e);
    } finally {
      setScanning(false);
    }
  };

  const handleTestConnection = async (provider, modelName, apiKey, baseUrl) => {
    setTestingProvider(provider);
    setTestResult(prev => ({ ...prev, [provider]: { testing: true } }));
    try {
      const res = await axios.post('/api/llm/test-connection', {
        provider,
        model_name: modelName,
        api_key: apiKey,
        base_url: baseUrl
      });
      setTestResult(prev => ({ ...prev, [provider]: res.data }));
    } catch (e) {
      setTestResult(prev => ({
        ...prev,
        [provider]: { success: false, message: e.response?.data?.detail || e.message }
      }));
    } finally {
      setTestingProvider(null);
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await axios.post('/api/settings', settings);
      if (onSettingsSaved) onSettingsSaved(settings);
      onClose();
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Lỗi lưu cài đặt: " + (e.response?.data?.detail || e.message));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleShowKey = (field) => {
    setShowKeys(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: !prev[field] }));
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/75 backdrop-blur-sm p-4 animate-fade-in font-sans">
      <div className="bg-[#181a20] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col shadow-2xl overflow-hidden">
        
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-5 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between bg-white/[0.02]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/10 border border-blue-500/20 flex items-center justify-center text-blue-400">
              <Cpu size={22} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Cấu hình Bộ Não AI</h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Cắm bất kỳ Local AI hoặc Cloud API nào một cách dễ dàng</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-white/5 transition">
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="flex border-b border-white/10 px-5 bg-white/[0.01]">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('local')}
            className={`py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold border-b-2 flex items-center gap-2 transition-all ${
              activeTab === 'local'
                ? 'border-green-500 text-green-400'
                : 'border-transparent text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200'
            }`}
          >
            <Server size={15} /> Local AI (Ollama / Trên máy)
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('9router')}
            className={`py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold border-b-2 flex items-center gap-2 transition-all ${
              activeTab === '9router'
                ? 'border-purple-500 text-purple-400'
                : 'border-transparent text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200'
            }`}
          >
            <Cpu size={15} /> 9Router Gateway
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('cloud')}
            className={`py-3 px-4 text-xs font-semibold border-b-2 flex items-center gap-2 transition-all ${
              activeTab === 'cloud'
                ? 'border-blue-500 text-blue-400'
                : 'border-transparent text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-200'
            }`}
          >
            <Cloud size={15} /> Cloud AI (API Key)
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Content */}
        <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto flex-1 space-y-6 scrollbar-hide">
          
          {/* TAB 1: LOCAL AI */}
          {activeTab === 'local' && (
            <div className="space-y-6 animate-fade-in">
              {/* Ollama Section */}
              <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 space-y-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-white">Ollama</span>
                    {localStatus?.ollama?.available ? (
                      <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 border border-green-500/30 flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-green-400 animate-pulse"></span> Đã kết nối ({localStatus.ollama.models.length} model)
                      </span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border border-red-500/30">
                        Chưa tìm thấy
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <button 
                    onClick={scanLocalModels} 
                    disabled={scanning}
                    className="text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-white bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-white/10 transition"
                  >
                    <RefreshCw size={13} className={scanning ? 'animate-spin' : ''} /> Quét lại
                  </button>
                </div>

                {localStatus?.ollama?.available ? (
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-400 mb-1.5">Chọn Model Ollama mặc định:</label>
                      <select
                        value={settings.default_model}
                        onChange={e => setSettings({ ...settings, default_model: e.target.value })}
                        className="w-full bg-[#121316] border border-white/15 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-sm text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-green-500"
                      >
                        {localStatus.ollama.models.map(m => (
                          <option key={m.name} value={m.name}>
                            {m.name} ({m.size_gb} GB - {m.details?.parameter_size || 'Local'})
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <input 
                        type="text" 
                        value={settings.ollama_base_url} 
                        onChange={e => setSettings({ ...settings, ollama_base_url: e.target.value })}
                        placeholder="http://localhost:11434"
                        className="flex-1 bg-black/40 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-gray-300 focus:outline-none focus:border-green-500 font-mono"
                      />
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleTestConnection('ollama', settings.default_model, '', settings.ollama_base_url)}
                        disabled={testingProvider === 'ollama'}
                        className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-green-500/10 text-green-400 border border-green-500/30 hover:bg-green-500/20 transition flex items-center gap-1"
                      >
                        {testingProvider === 'ollama' ? <RefreshCw size={12} className="animate-spin" /> : <Check size={12} />}
                        Test
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {testResult.ollama && (
                      <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs border ${testResult.ollama.success ? 'bg-green-500/10 text-green-300 border-green-500/30' : 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-300 border-red-500/30'}`}>
                        {testResult.ollama.message}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="p-3 bg-yellow-500/10 border border-yellow-500/20 rounded-xl text-xs text-yellow-300/90 leading-relaxed">
                    💡 <strong>Mẹo cho người dùng mới:</strong> Cài ứng dụng <strong>Ollama</strong> (từ ollama.com) rồi chạy lệnh ví dụ <code>ollama run qwen2.5:3b</code> hoặc mở app lên là hệ thống tự động nhận diện 100%!
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* LM Studio / Local OpenAI Compatible */}
              <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 space-y-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-white">LM Studio / vLLM / LocalAI</span>
                  {localStatus?.lm_studio?.available ? (
                    <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 border border-green-500/30">
                      Sẵn sàng
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">Cổng 1234</span>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-medium text-gray-400 mb-1">Địa chỉ Local Endpoint:</label>
                    <input 
                      type="text" 
                      value={settings.lm_studio_base_url}
                      onChange={e => setSettings({ ...settings, lm_studio_base_url: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder="http://localhost:1234/v1"
                      className="w-full bg-black/40 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 font-mono"

                  </div>

                      type="text" 
                      value={settings.custom_model || 'local-model'}

                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => handleTestConnection('lm_studio', settings.custom_model || 'local-model', '', settings.lm_studio_base_url)}
                  disabled={testingProvider === 'lm_studio'}
                  className="w-full py-2 text-xs font-semibold rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-gray-200 border border-white/10 transition flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
                >
                  {testingProvider === 'lm_studio' ? <RefreshCw size={12} className="animate-spin" /> : null}

                </button>

                {testResult.lm_studio && (
                  <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs border ${testResult.lm_studio.success ? 'bg-green-500/10 text-green-300 border-green-500/30' : 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-300 border-red-500/30'}`}>
                    {testResult.lm_studio.message}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 2: 9ROUTER GATEWAY */}
          {activeTab === '9router' && (
            <div className="space-y-5 animate-fade-in">

                >

                    />

                      className="absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-white"

                    </button>

                      value={settings.openai_model || 'gpt-4o-mini'}

                >
                  {testingProvider === 'openai' ? <RefreshCw size={12} className="animate-spin" /> : null}
                  Kiểm tra OpenAI Key

                {testResult.openai && (

                      <option value="llama-3.3-70b-versatile">llama-3.3-70b</option>
                      <option value="llama-3.1-8b-instant">llama-3.1-8b (Flash)</option>
                      <option value="mixtral-8x7b-32768">mixtral-8x7b</option>

                  </div>

                  disabled={testingProvider === 'groq' || !settings.groq_api_key}
                  className="px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-lg bg-purple-500/10 text-purple-400 border border-purple-500/30 hover:bg-purple-500/20 disabled:opacity-40 transition flex items-center gap-1.5"
                >
                  {testingProvider === 'groq' ? <RefreshCw size={12} className="animate-spin" /> : null}
                  Kiểm tra Groq Key
                </button>

                {testResult.groq && (
                  <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs border ${testResult.groq.success ? 'bg-green-500/10 text-green-300 border-green-500/30' : 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-300 border-red-500/30'}`}>
                    {testResult.groq.message}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

            </div>
          )}

        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="p-4 border-t border-white/10 bg-white/[0.02] flex items-center justify-between">
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">Cài đặt được lưu trữ an toàn trong máy tính của bạn.</p>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-gray-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition"
            >
              Đóng
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleSave}
              disabled={loading}
              className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-200 transition shadow-lg flex items-center gap-1.5 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {loading ? <RefreshCw size={14} className="animate-spin" /> : <Check size={14} />}
              Lưu Cài Đặt
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

# FILE: frontend/src/components/ShareModal.jsx

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Share2, Copy, Check, Download, BookOpen, Link, FileJson } from 'lucide-react';

export default function ShareModal({ isOpen, onClose, notebook, studyGuide, onExportJson, isDark = true }) {
  const [copiedLink, setCopiedLink] = useState(false);
  const [copiedSummary, setCopiedSummary] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const currentUrl = window.location.href;

  const handleCopyLink = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(currentUrl);
    setCopiedLink(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedLink(false), 2000);
  };

  const handleCopySummary = () => {
    if (!studyGuide) return;
    const text = `# ${notebook?.title || "NotebookLM Sổ tay"}\n\n## Tóm tắt Cốt lõi\n${studyGuide.summary || ""}\n\n## Thuật ngữ Quan trọng\n${studyGuide.glossary || ""}\n\n## Câu hỏi ôn tập\n${studyGuide.faq || ""}`;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    setCopiedSummary(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedSummary(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md p-4 animate-fade-in font-sans">
      <div className={`w-full max-w-lg rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border overflow-hidden p-6 transition-colors ${
        isDark ? 'bg-[#181a20] border-white/15 text-white' : 'bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-900'
      }`}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-4 border-b border-white/10">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/30">
              <Share2 size={18} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold">Chia sẻ & Xuất Sổ tay</h3>
              <p className={`text-xs ${isDark ? 'text-gray-400' : 'text-gray-500'}`}>{notebook?.title || "Sổ tay nghiên cứu"}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button 
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/5 transition"
          >
            <X size={18} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-4 my-5">
          {/* Option 1: Share Link */}
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 space-y-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-300 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Link size={14} className="text-blue-400" /> Liên kết trực tiếp tới Sổ tay:
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <input
                type="text"
                readOnly
                value={currentUrl}
                className="w-full bg-black/40 text-xs px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-gray-300 font-mono border border-white/10 outline-none select-all"
              />
              <button
                onClick={handleCopyLink}
                className="px-3 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1"
              >
                {copiedLink ? <Check size={14} /> : <Copy size={14} />}
                <span>{copiedLink ? "Đã chép" : "Chép link"}</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Option 2: Export JSON Bundle */}
          <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <FileJson size={14} className="text-green-400" /> Xuất bản sao lưu dữ liệu (.json)
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
                Bao gồm tài liệu, lịch sử chat, cẩm nang, thẻ Quizlet & tiến độ học.
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={onExportJson}
              className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow"
            >
              <Download size={14} />
              <span>Tải .json</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Option 3: Copy Study Guide Markdown */}
          {studyGuide && (
            <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <BookOpen size={14} className="text-purple-400" /> Sao chép Cẩm nang tóm tắt
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">
                  Dạng văn bản Markdown hoàn chỉnh để gửi qua tin nhắn hoặc in ấn.
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={handleCopySummary}
                className="px-3.5 py-2 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow"
              >
                {copiedSummary ? <Check size={14} /> : <Copy size={14} />}
                <span>{copiedSummary ? "Đã chép" : "Chép tóm tắt"}</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="pt-2 flex justify-end">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold transition"
          >
            Đóng
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Clock, ListTree, RefreshCw, Sparkles, MessageSquare, ChevronDown, ChevronRight, Tag } from 'lucide-react';

export default function TimelineOutlineModal({ 
  isOpen, 
  onClose, 
  data, 
  onRegenerate, 
  loading, 
  onAskAboutTopic, 
  isDark = true 
}) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('timeline'); // 'timeline' | 'outline'
  const [focusTopic, setFocusTopic] = useState('');
  const [expandedSections, setExpandedSections] = useState({ 0: true, 1: true });

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const timelineItems = data?.timeline || [];
  const outlineItems = data?.outline || [];

  const toggleSection = (idx) => {
    setExpandedSections(prev => ({ ...prev, [idx]: !prev[idx] }));
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md p-4 animate-fade-in font-sans">
      <div className={`w-full max-w-4xl h-[88vh] flex flex-col rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border overflow-hidden transition-colors ${
        isDark ? 'bg-[#14151a] border-white/15 text-white' : 'bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-900'
      }`}>
        {/* Header */}
        <div className={`p-4 border-b flex items-center justify-between ${
          isDark ? 'bg-white/[0.02] border-white/10' : 'bg-gray-50 border-gray-200'
        }`}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 bg-gradient-to-tr from-emerald-500 to-teal-600 rounded-xl text-white shadow-md">
              <Clock size={20} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                Dòng thời gian & Dàn ý Bài học
                <span className="text-[11px] font-normal px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30">
                  Timeline & Outline
                </span>
              </h2>
              <p className={`text-xs ${isDark ? 'text-gray-400' : 'text-gray-500'}`}>
                Trích xuất niên biểu tiến trình và dàn ý phân cấp có hệ thống từ tài liệu
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className={`p-2 rounded-xl transition ${isDark ? 'hover:bg-white/10 text-gray-400 hover:text-white' : 'hover:bg-gray-100 text-gray-500 hover:text-black'}`}
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Action & Tab Header */}
        <div className={`px-5 py-3 border-b flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 ${
          isDark ? 'bg-black/20 border-white/10' : 'bg-gray-50/70 border-gray-200'
        }`}>
          {/* Tab Switcher */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-white/5 p-1 rounded-xl border border-white/10">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('timeline')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition ${
                activeTab === 'timeline' 
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow' 
                  : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <Clock size={14} />
              <span>Dòng thời gian ({timelineItems.length})</span>
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('outline')}
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition ${
                activeTab === 'outline' 
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow' 
                  : 'text-gray-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <ListTree size={14} />
              <span>Dàn ý phân cấp ({outlineItems.length})</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Regenerate controls */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-1 max-w-md justify-end">
            <input
              type="text"
              value={focusTopic}
              onChange={e => setFocusTopic(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Chủ đề trọng tâm cần tập trung..."
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs border outline-none w-full max-w-[220px] transition ${
                isDark ? 'bg-white/5 border-white/10 text-white focus:border-emerald-500' : 'bg-white border-gray-200 text-black'
              }`}
            />
            <button
              onClick={() => onRegenerate(focusTopic)}
              disabled={loading}
              className="bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 to-teal-600 hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-50 text-white px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold shadow transition flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0"
            >
              <RefreshCw size={12} className={loading ? "animate-spin" : ""} />
              <span>{loading ? "Đang tạo..." : "Tái tạo"}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Content Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-6 scrollbar-hide">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full gap-3 text-gray-400">
              <RefreshCw size={30} className="animate-spin text-emerald-400" />
              <p className="text-sm font-medium">AI đang trích xuất mốc sự kiện và xây dựng khung dàn ý...</p>
            </div>
          ) : activeTab === 'timeline' ? (
            /* Timeline View */
            timelineItems.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full gap-2 text-gray-400">
                <Clock size={36} className="text-gray-500" />
                <p className="text-sm">Chưa có dữ liệu dòng thời gian. Nhấn "Tái tạo" để bắt đầu.</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="relative pl-6 space-y-6 max-w-2xl mx-auto before:absolute before:left-2 before:top-2 before:bottom-2 before:w-0.5 before:bg-gradient-to-b before:from-emerald-500 before:via-teal-500 before:to-emerald-500/20">
                {timelineItems.map((item, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="relative group">
                    {/* Node Dot */}
                    <div className="absolute -left-[27px] top-1.5 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 border-4 border-[#14151a] shadow-md group-hover:scale-125 transition"></div>

                    {/* Card */}
                    <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/10 hover:border-emerald-500/40 transition shadow-sm space-y-1.5">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                          {item.period || `Mốc ${idx + 1}`}
                        </span>
                        {item.tag && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/20 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <Tag size={10} />
                            {item.tag}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white group-hover:text-emerald-300 transition">
                        {item.title}
                      </h4>

                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-300 leading-relaxed pt-1">
                        {item.description}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )
          ) : (
            /* Outline View */
            outlineItems.length === 0 ? (
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full gap-2 text-gray-400">
                <ListTree size={36} className="text-gray-500" />
                <p className="text-sm">Chưa có dàn ý bài học. Nhấn "Tái tạo" để bắt đầu.</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-4 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
                {outlineItems.map((section, idx) => {
                  const isExpanded = !!expandedSections[idx];
                  return (
                    <div 
                      key={section.id || idx}
                      className="rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white/[0.03] overflow-hidden"
                    >
                      {/* Section Header */}
                      <div 
                        onClick={() => toggleSection(idx)}
                        className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer hover:bg-white/5 transition"
                      >
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                          {isExpanded ? <ChevronDown size={18} className="text-emerald-400" /> : <ChevronRight size={18} className="text-gray-400" />}
                          <div>
                            <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-white">{section.title}</h4>
                            {section.summary && (
                              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5 line-clamp-1">{section.summary}</p>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <button
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            onAskAboutTopic(`Hãy giải thích chi tiết và đưa ra ví dụ về: "${section.title}"`);
                            onClose();
                          }}
                          className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold bg-emerald-500/10 hover:bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center gap-1.5 transition shrink-0"
                          title="Gửi câu hỏi này sang khung trò chuyện AI"
                        >
                          <MessageSquare size={12} />
                          <span>Hỏi AI</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      {/* Subsections */}
                      {isExpanded && section.subsections && (
                        <div className="p-4 pt-1 border-t border-white/10 space-y-3 bg-black/20">
                          {section.subsections.map((sub, sIdx) => (
                            <div key={sub.id || sIdx} className="pl-3 border-l-2 border-emerald-500/40 space-y-1">
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                <h5 className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-200">{sub.title}</h5>
                                <button
                                  onClick={() => {
                                    onAskAboutTopic(`Phân tích chuyên sâu về: "${sub.title}"`);
                                    onClose();
                                  }}
                                  className="text-[11px] text-emerald-400 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1"
                                >
                                  <MessageSquare size={11} /> Hỏi mục này
                                </button>
                              </div>
                              {sub.points && sub.points.length > 0 && (
                                <ul className="list-disc list-inside text-xs text-gray-400 space-y-0.5 pl-1">
                                  {sub.points.map((pt, pIdx) => (
                                    <li key={pIdx}>{pt}</li>
                                  ))}
                                </ul>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

# FILE: frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx
# ==============================================================================

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { BookOpen, Plus, Search, Check, Settings, Trash2, Cpu, Cloud, Server, ExternalLink, Sun, Moon, Upload, FileJson } from 'lucide-react';
import axios from 'axios';
import SettingsModal from '../components/SettingsModal';

function Dashboard() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [notebooks, setNotebooks] = useState([]);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);
  const [showSettings, setShowSettings] = useState(false);

  // Theme state
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState(() => localStorage.getItem('notebooklm_theme') || 'dark');
  const toggleTheme = () => {
    const next = theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
    setTheme(next);
    localStorage.setItem('notebooklm_theme', next);
  };
  const isDark = theme === 'dark';

  // Import Notebook state
  const importInputRef = useRef(null);
  const [importing, setImporting] = useState(false);

  const handleImportFile = async (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setImporting(true);
    try {
      const text = await file.text();
      const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
      const res = await axios.post('/api/notebooks/import', parsed);
      if (res.data && res.data.notebook_id) {
        alert("Nhập sổ tay thành công!");
        fetchNotebooks();
        navigate(`/notebook/${res.data.notebook_id}`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Lỗi nhập sổ tay: " + (err.response?.data?.detail || err.message));
    } finally {
      setImporting(false);
      if (importInputRef.current) importInputRef.current.value = "";
    }
  };

  // Create Notebook Form State
  const [newTitle, setNewTitle] = useState('');
  const [provider, setProvider] = useState('ollama'); // 'ollama', 'lm_studio', 'gemini', 'openai', 'groq'
  const [selectedModel, setSelectedModel] = useState('');
  const [customKey, setCustomKey] = useState('');
  const [globalSettings, setGlobalSettings] = useState({});
  const [localModels, setLocalModels] = useState([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchNotebooks();
    fetchSettingsAndModels();
  }, []);

  const fetchNotebooks = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await axios.get('/api/notebooks');
      setNotebooks(res.data);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const fetchSettingsAndModels = async () => {
    try {
      const [settingsRes, modelsRes] = await Promise.all([
        axios.get('/api/settings'),
        axios.get('/api/llm/local-models')
      ]);
      setGlobalSettings(settingsRes.data || {});
      const ollamaModels = modelsRes.data?.ollama?.models || [];
      setLocalModels(ollamaModels);
      if (ollamaModels.length > 0 && !selectedModel) {
        setSelectedModel(ollamaModels[0].name);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    }
  };

  const handleOpenCreateModal = () => {
    fetchSettingsAndModels();
    setNewTitle('');
    setCustomKey('');
    setShowModal(true);
  };

  const handleDeleteNotebook = async (e, id) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (!window.confirm("Bạn có chắc chắn muốn xóa Sổ tay này cùng toàn bộ tài liệu bên trong không?")) return;
    try {
      await axios.delete(`/api/notebooks/${id}`);
      setNotebooks(prev => prev.filter(nb => nb.id !== id));
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Lỗi xóa sổ tay: " + (err.response?.data?.detail || err.message));
    }
  };

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!newTitle.trim()) return;

    let finalKey = customKey.trim();
    if (!finalKey) {
      if (provider === 'gemini') finalKey = globalSettings.gemini_api_key || '';
      else if (provider === 'openai') finalKey = globalSettings.openai_api_key || '';
      else if (provider === 'groq') finalKey = globalSettings.groq_api_key || '';
    }

    if (['gemini', 'openai', 'groq'].includes(provider) && !finalKey) {
      alert(`Vui lòng nhập API Key cho ${provider.toUpperCase()} hoặc cài đặt trong phần Cài đặt!`);
      return;
    }
    
    const id = Date.now().toString();
    const isPrivate = ['ollama', 'lm_studio'].includes(provider);

    try {
      await axios.post('/api/notebooks', {
        id,
        title: newTitle.trim(),
        is_private: isPrivate,
        provider,
        model_name: selectedModel || undefined,
        api_key: finalKey || undefined
      });
      setShowModal(false);
      navigate(`/notebook/${id}`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      alert('Lỗi tạo sổ ghi chú: ' + (err.response?.data?.detail || err.message));
    }
  };

  const filteredNotebooks = notebooks.filter(nb => 
    nb.title.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase())
  );

  const getProviderBadge = (nb) => {
    const prov = (nb.provider || (nb.is_private ? 'ollama' : 'gemini')).toLowerCase();
    if (prov === 'ollama') {
      return {
        label: `Ollama: ${nb.model_name || 'qwen2.5:3b'}`,
        color: 'bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 border-green-500/30'
      };
    }
    if (prov === 'lm_studio') {
      return {
        label: `LM Studio: ${nb.model_name || 'Local'}`,
        color: 'bg-teal-500/20 text-teal-300 border-teal-500/30'
      };
    }
    if (prov === 'gemini') {
      return {
        label: `Gemini: ${nb.model_name || 'Flash'}`,
        color: 'bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30'
      };
    }
    if (prov === 'groq') {
      return {
        label: `Groq: ${nb.model_name || 'Llama'}`,
        color: 'bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-400 border-purple-500/30'
      };
    }
    return {
      label: `${prov.toUpperCase()}: ${nb.model_name || ''}`,
      color: 'bg-gray-500/20 text-gray-300 border-gray-500/30'
    };
  };

  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-col min-h-screen font-sans w-full transition-colors ${
      isDark ? 'bg-[#121316] text-white selection:bg-blue-500/30' : 'bg-[#f8fafc] text-slate-900 selection:bg-blue-200'
    }`}>
      {/* Hidden file input for notebook import */}
      <input
        type="file"
        ref={importInputRef}
        onChange={handleImportFile}
        accept=".json"
        className="hidden"
      />

      {/* Header */}
      <header className={`flex justify-between items-center px-6 py-4 border-b transition-colors ${
        isDark ? 'border-white/5 bg-[#14161a]' : 'border-slate-200 bg-white'
      }`}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => navigate('/')}>
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold shadow-md">
            <BookOpen size={18} />
          </div>
          <span className="font-semibold text-lg tracking-tight">NotebookLM Mini</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          {/* Theme Switcher */}
          <button 
            onClick={toggleTheme}
            className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center transition border ${
              isDark ? 'border-white/10 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-amber-400' : 'border-slate-200 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-700'
            }`}

                  9Router Gateway
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Model selection based on provider */}
              {provider === '9router' && (
                <div className="bg-black/30 p-3 rounded-xl border border-white/10 space-y-2">

                  >

                    <option value="kr/deepseek-3.2">kr/deepseek-3.2 (DeepSeek V3.2 🔥 Mới nhất)</option>
                    <option value="kr/auto">kr/auto (Tự động định tuyến tối ưu)</option>
                    <option value="kr/glm-5">kr/glm-5 (GLM 5.0)</option>
                    <option value="kr/qwen3-coder-next">kr/qwen3-coder-next (Qwen 3 Coder Next)</option>
                    <option value="gemini-2.5-flash">gemini-2.5-flash (Google Gemini)</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              )}

              {provider === 'ollama' && (
                <div className="bg-black/30 p-3 rounded-xl border border-white/10 space-y-2">
                  <label className="block text-xs text-gray-400 font-medium">Chọn mô hình trong Ollama:</label>
                  {localModels.length > 0 ? (
                    <select
                      value={selectedModel}
                      onChange={e => setSelectedModel(e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full bg-[#121316] border border-white/15 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-green-500"
                    >
                      {localModels.map(m => (
                        <option key={m.name} value={m.name}>
                          {m.name} ({m.size_gb} GB)
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  ) : (
                    <input 
                      type="text" 
                      value={selectedModel} 
                      onChange={e => setSelectedModel(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="VD: qwen2.5:3b hoặc llama3.2"
                      className="w-full bg-black/40 border border-white/15 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-green-500"
                    />
                  )}
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">
                    {localModels.length > 0 ? `Đã phát hiện ${localModels.length} mô hình sẵn có trên máy.` : 'Không tìm thấy Ollama đang chạy, bạn vẫn có thể nhập tên model.'}
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Cloud API Key field */}
              {['gemini', 'openai', 'groq'].includes(provider) && (
                <div className="bg-black/30 p-3 rounded-xl border border-white/10 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <label className="text-xs text-gray-300 font-medium">
                      {provider.toUpperCase()} API Key:
                    </label>
                    {globalSettings[`${provider}_api_key`] && !customKey && (
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-green-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Check size={12} /> Đã có Key trong Cài đặt
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <input 
                    type="password" 
                    value={customKey}
                    onChange={e => setCustomKey(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder={globalSettings[`${provider}_api_key`] ? "Dùng key đã lưu (hoặc dán key khác vào đây)" : "Dán API Key vào đây..."}
                    className="w-full bg-black/50 border border-white/15 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-blue-500 font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-3 border-t border-white/10">
              <button 
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowModal(false)}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-gray-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 transition"
              >
                Hủy
              </button>
              <button 
                type="button"
                onClick={handleCreate}
                disabled={!newTitle.trim()}
                className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-200 disabled:opacity-50 transition shadow-lg"
              >
                Tạo sổ ghi chú
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Global Settings Modal */}
      <SettingsModal 
        isOpen={showSettings} 
        onClose={() => setShowSettings(false)} 
        onSettingsSaved={() => {
          fetchSettingsAndModels();
        }}
      />

    </div>
  );
}

export default Dashboard;

  // Critique & Action Plan State
  const [critiqueModal, setCritiqueModal] = useState({ isOpen: false, type: '', title: '', content: '', loading: false });

  // Tools definition for Studio Analysis
  const tools = [
    { id: 'critique', name: 'Phản biện AI', desc: 'Tìm lỗ hổng & góc nhìn phản biện', icon: ShieldAlert, endpoint: '/api/studio/critique', color: 'text-rose-600', bg: 'bg-rose-50' },

  // Suggested questions extracted from studyGuide.faq

    const lines = studyGuide.faq.split('\n');
    const questions = [];
    for (const line of lines) {
      let clean = line.trim()
        .replace(/^#+\s*/, '')
        .replace(/^\*+\s*/, '')
        .replace(/^-\s*/, '')
        .replace(/^[0-9]+[.)]\s*/, '')
        .replace(/\*+/g, '')
        .trim();
      clean = clean.replace(/^[0-9]+[.)]\s*/, '').trim();
      if (clean.endsWith('?') && clean.length > 8 && clean.length < 140) {
        questions.push(clean);
      }
    }
    return questions.slice(0, 4);
  }, [studyGuide?.faq]);

  const messagesEndRef = useRef(null);

  // Global Keyboard Shortcuts
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e) => {
      // Escape closes open modals or stops generation
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (loading) {
          handleStopGenerating();
          return;
        }
        setShowModelPicker(false);
        setShowChatSearch(false);
        setShowSettings(false);
        setShowQuiz(false);
        setShowFlashcards(false);
        setShowEvalModal(false);
        setShowGuideConfigModal(false);
        setShowPodcastModal(false);
        setPreviewDoc(null);
        setShowMindmapModal(false);
        setShowDocCompareModal(false);
        setShowTimelineModal(false);
        setShowShortcutsModal(false);
        setShowShareModal(false);
        setShowModelManagerModal(false);
        setShowPasteTextModal(false);
        setInspectDoc(null);
        setCritiqueModal(prev => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }));
        return;
      }

      // Check for Cmd/Ctrl modifier
      const isCmdOrCtrl = e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey;
      if (!isCmdOrCtrl) return;

      if (e.key === 'k' || e.key === 'K') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setShowModelPicker(prev => !prev);
      } else if (e.key === 'f' || e.key === 'F') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setShowChatSearch(prev => !prev);
      } else if (e.key === '/') {
        e.preventDefault();
        chatInputRef.current?.focus();
      } else if (e.shiftKey && (e.key === 's' || e.key === 'S')) {
        e.preventDefault();
        setShowSettings(prev => !prev);
      } else if (e.shiftKey && (e.key === 'q' || e.key === 'Q')) {
        e.preventDefault();
        setShowFlashcards(prev => !prev);
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, []);

  // Auto scroll
  const scrollToBottom = () => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    scrollToBottom();
  }, [messages]);

  // Fetch data khi mount
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return;
    fetchNotebookDetails();
    fetchLocalModels();
  }, [id]);

  const fetchNotebookDetails = async () => {
    try {
      const nbRes = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${id}`);
      if (!nbRes.ok) throw new Error("Không tìm thấy sổ tay");
      const nb = await nbRes.json();
      setActiveNotebook(nb);
      
      const msgRes = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${nb.id}/messages`);
      const msgs = await msgRes.json();
      if (msgs && msgs.length > 0) {
        setMessages(msgs);
      } else {
        const modelLabel = nb.model_name ? ` (${nb.provider?.toUpperCase()}: ${nb.model_name})` : '';
        setMessages([{ 
          role: 'assistant', 
          content: `Xin chào! Bạn đang ở sổ tay "${nb.title}"${modelLabel}. Hãy tải tài liệu hoặc gửi link bài viết/YouTube để bắt đầu hỏi đáp nhé!`, 
          citations: [] 
        }]);
      }

      const guideRes = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${nb.id}/study-guide`);
      if (guideRes.ok) {
        const guide = await guideRes.json();
        setStudyGuide(guide);
      }

      const docRes = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${nb.id}/documents`);
      if (docRes.ok) {
        const docs = await docRes.json();
        setDocuments(docs);
        setSelectedDocs(new Set(docs.map(d => d.filename)));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const fetchLocalModels = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/llm/local-models');
      const data = await res.json();
      setAvailableLocalModels(data?.ollama?.models || []);
      
      const storedCustom = localStorage.getItem('custom_ai_models');
      if (storedCustom) {
        setCustomSavedModels(JSON.parse(storedCustom));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Lỗi lấy local models:", e);
    }
  };

  // Switch model on the fly for active notebook
  const handleSwitchModel = async (newProvider, newModelName, newBaseUrl, newApiKey) => {
    setShowModelPicker(false);
    try {
      const payload = {
        provider: newProvider,
        model_name: newModelName,
        is_private: ['ollama', 'lm_studio', 'local_ai'].includes(newProvider)
      };
      if (newBaseUrl !== undefined) payload.base_url = newBaseUrl;
      if (newApiKey !== undefined) payload.api_key = newApiKey;

      const res = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/settings`, {
        method: 'PUT',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload)
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const updated = await res.json();
        setActiveNotebook(updated.notebook);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Lỗi đổi model:", e);
    }
  };

  // Quản lý việc chọn/bỏ chọn tài liệu làm ngữ cảnh
  const toggleSelectDoc = (filename) => {
    setSelectedDocs(prev => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(filename)) {
        next.delete(filename);
      } else {
        next.add(filename);
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleSelectAllDocs = () => {
    setSelectedDocs(new Set(documents.map(d => d.filename)));
  };

  const handleDeselectAllDocs = () => {
    setSelectedDocs(new Set());
  };

  // Polling Study Guide if it is null AND there are documents
  useEffect(() => {
    let intervalId;
    if (activeNotebook && !studyGuide && documents.length > 0) {
      intervalId = setInterval(async () => {
        try {
          const guideRes = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/study-guide`);
          if (guideRes.ok) {
            const guide = await guideRes.json();
            if (guide) {
              setStudyGuide(guide);
              clearInterval(intervalId);
            }
          }
        } catch (e) {
          console.error("Lỗi khi poll Study Guide:", e);
        }
      }, 3000);
    }
    return () => {
      if (intervalId) clearInterval(intervalId);
    };
  }, [activeNotebook, studyGuide, documents]);

  const handleRegenerateStudyGuide = async () => {
    if (!activeNotebook || regeneratingGuide) return;
    setRegeneratingGuide(true);
    try {
      await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/study-guide/regenerate`, { 
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...guideConfig,
          selected_documents: Array.from(selectedDocs)
        })
      });
      setStudyGuide(null); // Kích hoạt polling
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Lỗi khi yêu cầu tạo lại cẩm nang: " + e.message);
    } finally {
      setTimeout(() => setRegeneratingGuide(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  const handleGenerateCustomGuide = async () => {
    if (!activeNotebook || regeneratingGuide) return;
    setShowGuideConfigModal(false);
    setShowQuiz(false);
    setShowFlashcards(false);
    setRegeneratingGuide(true);
    try {
      await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/study-guide/regenerate`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          ...guideConfig,
          selected_documents: Array.from(selectedDocs)
        })
      });
      setStudyGuide(null); // Kích hoạt polling cập nhật giao diện
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Lỗi khi tạo lại cẩm nang: " + e.message);
    } finally {
      setTimeout(() => setRegeneratingGuide(false), 2000);
    }
  };

  const generatePodcast = async () => {
    if (!activeNotebook) return;
    setPodcastGenerating(true);
    setShowPodcastModal(false);
    setAudioUrl(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/podcast/generate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ 
          notebook_id: activeNotebook.id,
          focus_topic: podcastConfig.focus_topic,
          style: podcastConfig.style,
          selected_documents: Array.from(selectedDocs)
        })
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Lỗi khi gọi API tạo Podcast");
      
      // Polling kiểm tra file audio mỗi 2.5s (tối đa 25 lần ~ 60 giây)
      let attempts = 0;
      const pollAudio = setInterval(async () => {
        attempts += 1;
        try {
          const checkRes = await fetch(`/api/podcast/audio/${activeNotebook.id}`, { method: 'HEAD' });
          if (checkRes.ok) {
            clearInterval(pollAudio);
            setAudioUrl(`/api/podcast/audio/${activeNotebook.id}?t=${Date.now()}`);
            setPodcastGenerating(false);
          } else if (attempts >= 25) {
            clearInterval(pollAudio);
            setPodcastGenerating(false);
            alert("Quá thời gian tạo Podcast, vui lòng thử lại.");
          }
        } catch {
          if (attempts >= 25) {
            clearInterval(pollAudio);
            setPodcastGenerating(false);
          }
        }
      }, 2500);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
      alert("Lỗi tạo podcast: " + e.message);
      setPodcastGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyMessage = (content, idx) => {
    if (!content) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(content);
    setCopiedMsgIdx(idx);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedMsgIdx(null), 2000);
  };

  const handleExportChat = () => {
    if (!messages || messages.length === 0) {
      alert("Chưa có tin nhắn nào để xuất!");
      return;
    }
    let md = `# Sổ tay: ${activeNotebook?.title || 'NotebookLM'}\n\n`;
    md += `*Thời gian xuất: ${new Date().toLocaleString('vi-VN')}*\n`;
    md += `*Mô hình: ${currentProvider?.toUpperCase()}: ${currentModel}*\n\n`;
    md += `---\n\n`;

    messages.forEach((msg) => {
      const roleName = msg.role === 'user' ? '👤 **Người dùng:**' : '🤖 **Trợ lý AI:**';
      md += `${roleName}\n\n${msg.content || ''}\n\n`;
      if (msg.citations && msg.citations.length > 0) {
        md += `> **Trích dẫn nguồn:**\n`;
        msg.citations.forEach((c) => {
          md += `> - [${c.marker}] ${c.filename}\n`;
        });
        md += `\n`;
      }
      md += `---\n\n`;
    });

    const blob = new Blob([md], { type: 'text/markdown;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    const safeTitle = (activeNotebook?.title || 'cuoc_tro_chuyen').replace(/[\s/\\?%*:|"<>]/g, '_');
    a.download = `${safeTitle}_chat_history.md`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  // --- Feature #5: Message Delete & Clear ---
  const handleDeleteMessage = async (msgId, index) => {
    if (msgId) {
      try {
        await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/messages/${msgId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("Lỗi xóa tin nhắn:", e);
      }
    }
    setMessages(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const handleClearAllMessages = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm("Bạn có chắc chắn muốn xóa toàn bộ lịch sử trò chuyện của sổ tay này?")) return;
    try {
      await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/messages`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      setMessages([]);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Lỗi xóa toàn bộ hội thoại:", e);
    }
  };

  // --- Feature #10: Voice Input via Web Speech API ---
  const handleVoiceToggle = () => {
    const SpeechRecognition = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
    if (!SpeechRecognition) {
      alert("Trình duyệt hiện tại chưa hỗ trợ nhận diện giọng nói trực tiếp. Vui lòng dùng Chrome, Edge hoặc Cốc Cốc.");
      return;
    }

    if (isRecording) {
      if (recognitionRef.current) {
        try {
          recognitionRef.current.stop();
        } catch (_) {}
      }
      setIsRecording(false);
      return;
    }

    try {
      const recognition = new SpeechRecognition();
      recognition.lang = 'vi-VN';
      recognition.continuous = false;
      recognition.interimResults = true;

      // Lưu lại văn bản hiện có trước khi ghi âm để không bị ghi đè hoặc lặp
      voiceBaseTextRef.current = input.trim();

      recognition.onstart = () => setIsRecording(true);
      recognition.onresult = (event) => {
        let finalStr = '';
        let interimStr = '';
        for (let i = 0; i < event.results.length; ++i) {
          const item = event.results[i];
          if (item.isFinal) {
            finalStr += item[0]?.transcript || '';
          } else {
            interimStr += item[0]?.transcript || '';
          }
        }
        const spoken = (finalStr + interimStr).trim();
        if (spoken) {
          const base = voiceBaseTextRef.current;
          setInput(base ? `${base} ${spoken}` : spoken);
        }
      };
      recognition.onerror = (e) => {
        console.error("Lỗi nhận diện âm thanh:", e);
        setIsRecording(false);
      };
      recognition.onend = () => setIsRecording(false);

      recognitionRef.current = recognition;
      recognition.start();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setIsRecording(false);
    }
  };

  // --- Feature #13: Click Citation to Highlight in Preview ---
  const handleCitationClick = async (cit) => {
    setLoadingPreview(true);
    setHighlightSnippet(cit.snippet || null);
    setPreviewDoc({ filename: cit.filename, loading: true });
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/documents/preview?filename=${encodeURIComponent(cit.filename)}`);
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setPreviewDoc(data);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      setLoadingPreview(false);
    }
  };

  // --- Feature #8: Mindmap Handlers ---
  const handleOpenMindmap = async () => {
    setShowMindmapModal(true);
    if (!mindmapData) {
      setLoadingMindmap(true);
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/mindmap`);
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.mindmap) {
          setMindmapData(data.mindmap);
        } else {
          await handleRegenerateMindmap();
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
      } finally {
        setLoadingMindmap(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleRegenerateMindmap = async (topic = "") => {
    setLoadingMindmap(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/mindmap/generate`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ 
          focus_topic: topic,
          selected_documents: Array.from(selectedDocs)
        })
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errJson.detail || `Lỗi máy chủ (${res.status})`);
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.mindmap) {
        setMindmapData(data.mindmap);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Lỗi tạo sơ đồ tư duy: " + e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoadingMindmap(false);
    }
  };

  // --- Feature #15: Timeline & Outline Handlers ---
  const handleOpenTimeline = async () => {
    setShowTimelineModal(true);
    if (!timelineData) {
      setLoadingTimeline(true);
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/timeline-outline`);
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          if (data.timeline_outline) {
            setTimelineData(data.timeline_outline);
          } else {
            await handleRegenerateTimeline();
          }
        } else {
          await handleRegenerateTimeline();
        }
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
      } finally {
        setLoadingTimeline(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleRegenerateTimeline = async (topic = "") => {
    setLoadingTimeline(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/timeline-outline/generate`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ 
          focus_topic: topic,
          selected_documents: Array.from(selectedDocs)
        })
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errJson.detail || `Lỗi máy chủ (${res.status})`);
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.timeline_outline) {
        setTimelineData(data.timeline_outline);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Lỗi trích xuất dòng thời gian & dàn ý: " + e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoadingTimeline(false);
    }
  };

  // --- Feature #9: Document Comparison Handler ---
  const handleCompareDocs = async (selectedDocList, topic = "") => {
    setComparingDocs(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/documents/compare`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ filenames: selectedDocList, focus_topic: topic })
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        const errJson = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errJson.detail || `Lỗi máy chủ (${res.status})`);
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.comparison) {
        setComparisonResult(data.comparison);
      } else {
        alert("Không nhận được kết quả so sánh.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Lỗi khi so sánh tài liệu: " + e.message);
    } finally {
      setComparingDocs(false);
    }
  };


  // --- Feature #12: Export Notebook JSON ---
  const handleExportNotebookJson = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/export`);
      const data = await res.json();
      const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `notebook-${(activeNotebook.title || 'backup').replace(/[\s/\\?%*:|"<>]/g, '_')}-${Date.now()}.json`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Lỗi xuất dữ liệu: " + e.message);
    }
  };

  const handlePreviewDocument = async (filename) => {
    setHighlightSnippet(null);
    setLoadingPreview(true);
    setPreviewDoc({ filename, loading: true });
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/documents/preview?filename=${encodeURIComponent(filename)}`);
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setPreviewDoc(data);
      } else {
        setPreviewDoc({ filename, preview_text: "Không thể lấy nội dung xem trước của tài liệu này." });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setPreviewDoc({ filename, preview_text: "Lỗi kết nối khi xem trước tài liệu: " + e.message });
    } finally {
      setLoadingPreview(false);
    }
  };

  const handleInspectChunks = async (sourceName, e) => {
    if (e) e.stopPropagation();
    setInspectDoc(sourceName);
    setLoadingChunks(true);
    setChunkSearch('');
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/documents/chunks?source=${encodeURIComponent(sourceName)}&notebook_id=${activeNotebook?.id || ''}`);
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setDocChunks(data.chunks || []);
      } else {
        setDocChunks([]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Lỗi tải chunks:", err);
      setDocChunks([]);
    } finally {
      setLoadingChunks(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRunStudioTool = async (toolId) => {
    const isCritique = toolId === 'critique';
    const endpoint = isCritique ? '/api/studio/critique' : '/api/studio/action-plan';
    const title = isCritique ? 'Báo Cáo Phản Biện & Tìm Lỗ Hổng (Peer Review)' : 'Kế Hoạch Hành Động Thực Tiễn (Action Plan)';
    
    setCritiqueModal({ isOpen: true, type: toolId, title, content: '', loading: true });
    
    try {
      const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          notebook_id: activeNotebook?.id,
          source_filter: selectedDocs.size === 1 ? Array.from(selectedDocs)[0] : null,
          selected_documents: Array.from(selectedDocs)
        })
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setCritiqueModal({ isOpen: true, type: toolId, title, content: data.content || data.error || 'Không có kết quả phân tích.', loading: false });
      } else {
        const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        setCritiqueModal({ isOpen: true, type: toolId, title, content: err.detail || 'Lỗi khi gọi API phân tích.', loading: false });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setCritiqueModal({ isOpen: true, type: toolId, title, content: 'Lỗi kết nối máy chủ: ' + e.message, loading: false });
    }
  };

  const deleteNotebook = async () => {
    if (!activeNotebook) return;
    if (!window.confirm("Bạn có chắc chắn muốn xóa sổ tay này và toàn bộ dữ liệu bên trong không?")) return;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      if (res.ok) {
        navigate('/dashboard');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  const handleUrlSubmit = async () => {
    if (!urlInputValue.trim() || !activeNotebook) return;
    
    let urlToSubmit = urlInputValue.trim();
    if (!urlToSubmit.startsWith('http://') && !urlToSubmit.startsWith('https://')) {
      urlToSubmit = 'https://' + urlToSubmit;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    setShowUrlInput(false);
    setUploadingDocs(prev => [...prev, { filename: urlToSubmit }]);
    
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('url', urlToSubmit);
      formData.append('notebook_id', activeNotebook.id);

      const res = await fetch('/api/ingest/url', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: formData
      });
      
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Mã lỗi từ máy chủ: ${res.status}`);
      }

      await res.json();
      setUrlInputValue('');
      
      const docRes = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/documents`);
      if (docRes.ok) {
        const newDocs = await docRes.json();
        setDocuments(newDocs);
        setSelectedDocs(new Set(newDocs.map(d => d.filename)));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, { role: 'assistant', content: `Lỗi khi nạp link: ${e.message}`, citations: [] }]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      setUploadingDocs(prev => prev.filter(d => d.filename !== urlToSubmit));
    }
  };

  // Hỗ trợ tải lên NHIỀU FILE cùng lúc (Multi-file Upload)
  const handleFileUpload = async (e) => {
    if (!activeNotebook) return;
    const files = Array.from(e.target.files || []);
    if (files.length === 0) return;

    setUploading(true);
    setUploadingDocs(prev => [...prev, ...files.map(f => ({ filename: f.name }))]);

    for (const file of files) {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', file);
      formData.append('notebook_id', activeNotebook.id);

      try {
        const response = await fetch('/api/ingest/upload', {
          method: 'POST',
          body: formData,
        });
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Upload failed: ${file.name}`);
        await response.json();
        setSelectedDocs(prev => new Set([...prev, file.name]));
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
        setMessages(prev => [...prev, { role: 'assistant', content: `❌ Lỗi khi tải tệp "${file.name}": ${err.message}`, citations: [] }]);
      } finally {
        setUploadingDocs(prev => prev.filter(d => d.filename !== file.name));
      }
    }

    try {
      const docRes = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/documents`);
      if (docRes.ok) {
        const newDocs = await docRes.json();
        setDocuments(newDocs);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
      e.target.value = null;
    }
  };

  // Nạp văn bản dán trực tiếp (Paste Text)
  const handlePasteTextSubmit = async () => {
    if (!pasteContent.trim() || !activeNotebook) return;
    const tempTitle = pasteTitle.trim() || `Ghi chú (${new Date().toLocaleTimeString('vi-VN')}).txt`;
    setShowPasteTextModal(false);
    setUploading(true);
    setUploadingDocs(prev => [...prev, { filename: tempTitle }]);

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/ingest/text', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          notebook_id: activeNotebook.id,
          title: tempTitle,
          text: pasteContent
        })
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`Mã lỗi: ${res.status}`);
      const data = await res.json();
      setPasteTitle('');
      setPasteContent('');

      const docRes = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/documents`);
      if (docRes.ok) {
        const newDocs = await docRes.json();
        setDocuments(newDocs);
        setSelectedDocs(prev => new Set([...prev, data.filename || tempTitle]));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      alert("Lỗi khi nạp văn bản: " + e.message);
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
      setUploadingDocs(prev => prev.filter(d => d.filename !== tempTitle));
    }
  };

  const deleteDocument = async (filename) => {
    if (!activeNotebook) return;
    if (!window.confirm(`Bạn có chắc muốn xóa tài liệu "${filename}"?`)) return;
    
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/notebooks/${activeNotebook.id}/documents?filename=${encodeURIComponent(filename)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      if (res.ok) {
        setDocuments(prev => prev.filter(d => d.filename !== filename));
        setSelectedDocs(prev => {
          const next = new Set(prev);
          next.delete(filename);
          return next;
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Error deleting document:', err);
    }
  };

  const handleSend = async () => {
    if (!input.trim() || !activeNotebook) return;
    
    // Hủy bỏ request trước đó nếu còn đang chạy
    if (abortControllerRef.current) {
      abortControllerRef.current.abort();
    }
    abortControllerRef.current = new AbortController();

    const userMsg = input.trim();
    setInput('');
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, { role: 'user', content: userMsg }]);
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, { role: 'assistant', content: '', citations: [] }]);
      
      const response = await fetch('/api/chat', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        signal: abortControllerRef.current.signal,
        body: JSON.stringify({ 
          query: userMsg, 
          notebook_id: activeNotebook.id,
          provider: activeNotebook.provider,
          model_name: activeNotebook.model_name,
          selected_documents: Array.from(selectedDocs)
        })
      });

      const reader = response.body.getReader();
      const decoder = new TextDecoder("utf-8");
      
      let buffer = "";

      while (true) {
        const { value, done } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        
        buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
        
        const events = buffer.split('\n\n');
        buffer = events.pop() || "";
        
        for (const event of events) {
          if (event.startsWith("data: ")) {
            const dataStr = event.substring(6);
            try {
              const data = JSON.parse(dataStr);
              
              setMessages(prev => {
                const newMessages = [...prev];
                const lastIndex = newMessages.length - 1;
                
                if (data.type === 'citations') {
                  newMessages[lastIndex] = {
                    ...newMessages[lastIndex],
                    citations: data.citations
                  };
                } else if (data.type === 'chunk') {
                  newMessages[lastIndex] = {
                    ...newMessages[lastIndex],
                    content: newMessages[lastIndex].content + data.text,
                    status: null
                  };
                } else if (data.type === 'status') {
                  newMessages[lastIndex] = {
                    ...newMessages[lastIndex],
                    status: data.message
                  };
                } else if (data.type === 'saved') {
                  if (lastIndex >= 1 && data.user_msg_id) {
                    newMessages[lastIndex - 1] = { ...newMessages[lastIndex - 1], id: data.user_msg_id };
                  }
                  if (data.assistant_msg_id) {
                    newMessages[lastIndex] = { ...newMessages[lastIndex], id: data.assistant_msg_id };
                  }
                }
                
                return newMessages;
              });
            } catch (e) {
              console.error("Lỗi parse JSON SSE", e);
            }
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (err.name === 'AbortError') {
        console.log("Đã dừng tạo phản hồi.");
        return;
      }
      console.error(err);
      setMessages(prev => {
        const newMessages = [...prev];
        const lastIndex = newMessages.length - 1;
        newMessages[lastIndex] = {
          ...newMessages[lastIndex],
          content: 'Xin lỗi, có lỗi xảy ra khi kết nối tới LLM Engine.'
        };
        return newMessages;
      });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
      abortControllerRef.current = null;
    }
  };

  // Tính năng: Dừng câu trả lời ngay lập tức
  const handleStopGenerating = () => {
    if (abortControllerRef.current) {
